# cato_socket_lan_policy (Resource)

Account-level LAN Firewall policy enable/disable toggle. Delete is a no-op: the policy always exists.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cato_socket_lan_policy" "this" {
  enabled = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the LAN Firewall policy is enabled

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Fixed identifier for import
- `published_by` (String) Last published by from audit
- `published_time` (String) Last published time from audit
- `revision_id` (String) Active draft revision ID when present
- `revision_name` (String) Active draft revision name when present
